nodes.name: 🧠 NODE 1 — Analyzer AI
nodes.notes: Breaks the research topic into structured sections with title, image query, and key points for each section.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.writer.model, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are an expert academic writer writing a research paper on: "' + $json.topic + '". Title: "' + $json.paperTitle + '".' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Write the "' + $json.currentSection.title + '" section of an academic research paper about "' + $json.topic + '".

Key points to cover: ' + $json.currentSection.keyPoints + '
Length: approximately ' + ($json.depth === 'brief' ? 220 : $json.depth === 'deep' ? 600 : 380) + ' words
Style: formal academic, paragraph form, no bullet points
Do NOT include the section heading — only the body text.' }], max_tokens: 4096, temperature: 0.7 }) }}

nodes.name: ✍️ NODE 2 — Writer AI
nodes.notes: Writes detailed academic content for each section. Processes each section from the plan sequentially.

nodes.name: 🎨 NODE 3 — Pexels Images
nodes.notes: Fetches relevant landscape photos from Pexels for each section based on the image query from the Analyzer.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.combiner.model, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You are a senior academic editor. A research paper on "' + $json.topic + '" has been drafted.
Title: "' + $json.paperTitle + '"
Sections written: ' + $json.sections.map((s, i) => '[' + (i+1) + '] ' + s.title).join(', ') + '

Write a single final polished paragraph (max 120 words) that serves as the editor's note — summarizing the paper's contribution and significance. Keep it formal and impactful.' }], max_tokens: 2048, temperature: 0.7 }) }}

nodes.name: 📝 NODE 4 — Combiner AI
nodes.notes: Polishes the paper with an editor's note summarizing the paper's contribution and significance.
